inputs.master: Windows15/_state/ideas_master.jsonl from origin/cursor/p1-wave-b-batch001-consolidator-7c96 (271 accepted batch-001 hypotheses, used only for duplicate detection)

clustering_basis: Hypothesis-level: ideas grouped by shared falsifiable core claim and mechanism, not by keyword, shard, or domain. True near-duplicates (same claim, substantially the same experiment) are merged; template twins (same claim template, different domain/instrument/observable) are kept and recorded as cross-shard near-duplicate relations. Ideas whose falsifiable core is already accepted in the batch-001 master list are dropped with duplicate_of set to the master idea_id; ideas that share a template with a master idea but add distinct falsifiable content are kept and listed in master_near_duplicate_relations.

clusters.name: assignment_dynamics
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Label assignment is the hidden controller of detector supervision: assignment ambiguity, churn, and geometry-conditioned positive selection explain convergence, calibration noise, small/occluded-object deficits, duplicate-GT damage, and warmup requirements better than loss or architecture stories.

clusters.name: duplicate_suppression
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Duplicate suppression (NMS or learned query inhibition) is a first-class error source: suppressed candidates carry recoverable information, suppression policy destroys correct detections in crowds and large vocabularies, and its behavioral statistics fingerprint the mechanism.

clusters.name: box_regression_geometry
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Box regression losses and parameterizations impose systematic, measurable geometric biases (shrinkage under ambiguity, correlated edge errors, per-stage affine biases, cls-reg Pareto tradeoffs, size-dependent loss conditioning) that are partly correctable post hoc.

clusters.name: architecture_prior_geometry
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Architecture prior geometry (anchor/query portfolios, resize/preprocessing policy, loss insensitivity along long axes) creates sharp, configuration-predictable failure cliffs for extreme shapes and scene layouts rather than smooth difficulty gradients.

clusters.name: grid_phase_aliasing
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Sampling-grid quantization (stride and patch tokenization) makes detection/dense outputs a structured function of grid phase and patches-per-object: periodic error in sub-grid translation, integer-patch size cliffs, orientation aliasing, and sub-grid information that standard decoding discards.

clusters.name: windows_seams_positional
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Window, crop, and positional-embedding structure leaves content-independent spatial error signatures: attention-window seams, sliding-window and multi-crop boundaries, and PE-interpolation zones concentrate dense errors and set resolution-transfer breakdown points.

clusters.name: token_reduction_damage
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Token merging/pruning damage is structured and underreported: dense tasks and small, low-saliency objects absorb concentrated damage that VQA-style average metrics hide, predictably from merge-map geometry and token similarity.

clusters.name: small_object_scale_context
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Small-object perception is a distinct regime: recognition shifts from appearance to context, gains approach annotation-noise ceilings, the skill peaks early and is forgotten first, and architecture-preferred absolute-size bands (not scale invariance) drive scale-augmentation and tiling effects.

clusters.name: confidence_calibration_structure
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Confidence in detection/segmentation is a structured mixture (classification correctness, localization quality, duplicate rank, class frequency, boundary proximity, severity) whose components are separately miscalibrated; no scalar calibration fixes it and the mixture map predicts which fix works where.

clusters.name: threshold_transfer
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Score thresholds and operating points do not transfer across domains or query vocabularies; the shift is driven by background and vocabulary statistics rather than ranking degradation, and is largely recoverable by targeted label-free recalibration.

clusters.name: self_signal_failure_prediction
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: A model's own cheap internal signals (frozen-feature probes, input-jitter and paraphrase instability, box consistency, verbalized-vs-head disagreement) predict per-input failure better than confidence, and the residual unpredictable set is structurally distinct.

clusters.name: failure_set_structure
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Failure sets have low-dimensional backbone-level structure (shared feature directions, background-prototype coverage, feature confusability, adversarial-subspace alignment), enabling label-free failure forecasting and revealing ecosystem-wide correlated blind spots.

clusters.name: error_population_mining_bias
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: The error population is causally bimodal (confident/systematic vs diffident/ambiguous); confidence-based mining, repair fine-tuning, and auto-label loops lawfully act on the wrong mode, with measurable repair-damage budgets, amplification laws, and early-training determination of final failures.

clusters.name: cross_model_failure_correlation
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Failures correlate and propagate across the model ecosystem (shared web data, distillation lineages, scale families) with measurable transfer and decay laws that bound ensemble/cross-check safety and enable per-instance failure forecasting across generations.

clusters.name: annotation_convention_extent
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Annotation conventions of extent (modal/amodal mixtures, box tightness, shadow/reflection inclusion, contrast-edge snapping, vertex-budget curvature ceilings, blur-extent conventions) are learned by models and dominate a measurable share of cross-dataset, occlusion, and boundary error.

clusters.name: annotation_incompleteness_noise
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Annotation incompleteness and noise are structured (image borders, small scales, crowds/ignore regions, contested items) and are echoed by models as trained suppression, category-specific under-detection, and misleading benchmarks; targeted auditing dominates uniform noise treatment.

clusters.name: fine_grained_label_space
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Fine-grained and open label spaces fail through score-mass splitting over siblings, hypernym-dominated name embeddings, sense and compound-component leakage; separating label-space failure from perception failure recovers much apparent open-world loss.

clusters.name: metric_validity
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Standard aggregate metrics (mAP, bucketed size metrics, discrete IoU ladders, single-resolution evaluation) hide, misattribute, or are gameable relative to decision-relevant differences; decomposed, continuous, and rank-based metrics change conclusions with higher statistical power.

clusters.name: hidden_dof_protocol
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Hidden researcher degrees of freedom (class mappings, prompt curation, decoding configurations, background/ignore conventions, unstable slice-discovery tooling) move reported results by margins comparable to claimed method gains.

clusters.name: contamination_leakage
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Train/eval leakage through web-scale pretraining (image near-duplicates and class-frequency pseudo-novelty) inflates open-vocabulary and robustness results in measurable, stratifiable ways.

clusters.name: meta_failure_epistemology
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: The failure-analysis pipeline is itself biased: human adjudication limits what is ever evaluated, benchmark targeting migrates rather than removes failure mass, human causal labels misattribute mechanisms, and published failure maps are aesthetically curated relative to deployed harm.

clusters.name: absence_negation_hallucination
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Absence handling is broken by construction: negation words act as positive evidence, no architectural component models existence, hallucination follows co-occurrence priors predictable before inference, FP cost scales with vocabulary, and evaluations never charge for absent-query responses.

clusters.name: context_position_priors
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Learned scene priors (co-occurrence, per-image count, position-in-frame fingerprints, contextual plausibility suppression) causally modulate detection; their strength is measurable by paste/inpaint intervention and predicts augmentation outcomes and shift robustness.

clusters.name: spatial_score_interference
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Detections interfere spatially: large objects suppress nearby small-object scores asymmetrically, and background texture complexity drives FP generation, with architecture-characteristic interference ranges that predict clutter behavior.

clusters.name: part_whole_structure
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Part-whole structure is mishandled bidirectionally: detectors emit containment-inconsistent part/whole false positives removable by a training-free consistency test, while VLM part queries collapse to wholes in proportion to caption-mention statistics.

clusters.name: training_dynamics_detection
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Detection training has separable timescales and components (per-task and per-scale optima, positive-instance-governed gradient noise, background-logit sharpening, under-trained heads, objective-signature fossils) that single-checkpoint single-recipe training sacrifices.

clusters.name: deployment_streaming_robustness
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Deployment-time behavior (batch-1 normalization statistics, quantization asymmetry, threshold flicker, latency jitter, failure bursts) is governed by identifiable structural causes, and some apparently cosmetic instabilities are load-bearing early-warning signals.

clusters.name: corruption_shift_microstructure
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Robustness has microstructure: per-instance corruption cliffs, dominant interaction effects between nuisance factors, anisotropy across physical realizations, transition-regime failures, and superlinear clipping leakage; smooth population curves are aggregation artifacts.

clusters.name: pipeline_provenance_artifacts
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Preprocessing and provenance (JPEG entrainment, interpolation-kernel mismatch, EXIF/ICC handling, gamut clipping, normalization constants, video-artifact subdomains, resample signatures, ISP fingerprints, metadata clustering of hard cases) are first-order hidden covariates misattributed to content difficulty.

clusters.name: shortcut_spurious_cues
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Models exploit spurious incidental channels (compositing statistics, watermarks, embedded text) whose removal or transplantation collapses ostensibly visual capabilities by measurable amounts.

clusters.name: vlm_patch_representation_limits
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: VLM patch representations are globally leaked, anisotropic, outlier-token-dominated, and low-frequency-biased; token-statistics hygiene, layer selection, and readout choice - not decoder design or resolution - bound dense transfer, and norms already encode objectness.

clusters.name: text_query_bottleneck
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: The text tower binds much of open-vocabulary dense performance: classification-inherited templates, subword fragmentation, degenerate mass-noun regions, bag-of-words collapse; text-side fixes (renaming, rewriting, text-only adaptation) rival vision-side training.

clusters.name: web_frequency_determinism
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Web caption frequency and provenance are the dominant predictors of per-concept open-vocabulary and VLM performance - over visual difficulty covariates - across names, attributes, relations, viewpoints, languages, and caption styles.

clusters.name: spatial_relational_grounding
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Spatial and relational language is pattern-matched, not computed: relations, ordinals, numerals, reference frames, size comparatives, and speaker-relative expressions resolve to object priors, saliency ranks, pixel statistics, and corpus construction frequencies.

clusters.name: compositional_binding
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Pixel-level attribute-object binding fails lawfully: saliency-directed swaps, superlinear degradation with instance count and model-specific capacity knees, channel-sparse manipulable attribute coding, and a coverage tax for compositional data augmentation.

clusters.name: autoregressive_output_formats
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Autoregressive/textual dense output formats impose their own error structure (coordinate-vocabulary quantization, round-number priors, sequence-position drift, single-token information bottlenecks, CoT attention dilution, decoding-config sensitivity) independent of visual understanding, and reshape internal spatial representations.

clusters.name: vlm_depth_3d_priors
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: VLM-based depth and 3D are category- and prior-mediated (familiar size, y-position, language scale priors, metadata scale correlations, per-object piecewise-constant assignment) rather than geometric, and dissociate from spatial-QA competence.

clusters.name: vlm_language_prior_override
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: VLMs trade visual evidence against language priors at measurable thresholds with psychophysics-like laws: blindness points, counting numerosity signatures, chiral relation asymmetries, phrasing yes-bias, sycophancy dose-response, tick-label interpolation, and pixels-per-token hallucination scaling.

clusters.name: dense_adaptation_forgetting
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Dense finetuning damages open-vocabulary alignment early and abruptly, with paraphrase robustness collapsing first; breadth is better preserved by interpolation or distillation, and the required update is not low-intrinsic-dimension.

clusters.name: cross_domain_cross_lingual
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Open-vocabulary dense performance degrades disproportionately across languages, code-switching, modalities, and geographies, with the binding side (text vs vision) measurable per domain by asymmetric substitution.

clusters.name: referring_interactive_grounding
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Referring and interactive grounding is dominated by head-noun-plus-saliency shortcuts, lacks state for corrections and exclusions, and degrades with redundant expression length; benchmarks overstate true referring ability.

clusters.name: promptable_quality_score_failures
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Promptable-segmenter quality scores and granularity decisions fail conditioned on prompt atypicality and ambiguity, mis-ranking candidate masks exactly when prompts are unusual and compounding failure at selection time.

clusters.name: segmentation_structural_priors
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Segmenters carry structural priors mismatched to world structure: topology errors invisible to IoU-ranked mining, stuff/thing fragmentation thresholds, hole-filling, and missing scale anchoring form application-critical failure classes.

clusters.name: video_temporal_failures
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Video/temporal behavior is governed by rate, position, and geometry variables (motion-per-frame, occlusion memory horizons, blur direction relative to contours, evidence serial position, shuffle-invariant single-frame shortcuts) rather than content difficulty.

caveats: No novelty verification and no citation checking were performed (per task constraints); prior_art_risk flags and all high-value flags are leverage judgments, not verified novelty claims.
Master-duplicate decisions compare against ideas_master.jsonl as of the batch-001 consolidator branch; if the master list has since changed, duplicate_of targets should be revalidated.

Schema note: gen_A ideas carry cluster+evidence_class, gen_B carries cluster only, gen_C carries cluster+territory; field harmonization is still needed at master-ingestion time (same issue as batch 001).
